settings.title: A process built on
settings.intro: No black boxes, no 'trust us' reporting. Here's how a typical engagement runs from first call to a full pipeline.

steps.title: Audit
steps.text: We review your offer, your ICP, and your current funnel — and tell you honestly whether we can move the needle before you spend a dollar.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We assemble your target list, write the sequences, and set up the tracking. You approve the messaging before a single email goes out.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Outbound, inbound, and nurture go live together. You see every touchpoint in your CRM from day one — nothing hidden.

steps.title: Optimize
steps.text: We double down on what books meetings and cut what doesn't, every week. You get a pipeline report, not a vanity dashboard.

settings.note: Most clients see their first qualified meeting within two weeks of launch. We stay on as long as we're earning our keep.

settings.title: Questions buyers
settings.intro: Straight answers about pricing, targeting, and what working with Pipeline & Co. actually looks like.

items.question: How do you price your work?
items.answer: Our core model is per-qualified-meeting. You pay for meetings that land on your calendar and fit your ICP — not for activity, impressions, or 'leads' that go nowhere. We can also run blended retainers for larger programs.

items.question: What counts as a qualified meeting?
items.answer: A meeting with a decision-maker or economic buyer at a company that fits your ideal customer profile, who has confirmed they're open to a conversation about your solution. We agree the definition with you up front and report against it.

items.question: How fast will we see results?
items.answer: Most clients see their first qualified meeting within two weeks of launch. Building a consistent pipeline typically takes 60–90 days as we optimize messaging and targeting. We're transparent about the ramp from day one.

items.question: Do you work with any industry?
items.answer: We focus on B2B companies with a clear ICP and a sales team that can close. We're strongest in SaaS, fintech, logistics, manufacturing, and professional services — but we'll tell you honestly if we're not the right fit.

items.question: What do you need from us to start?
items.answer: A clear offer, access to your CRM, and a few hours with your sales team so we can learn how you sell. We handle the list building, messaging, and outreach from there.
